# Barn 0.9.2

Released on 2026-10-30. Barn 0.x releases use GitHub's pre-release channel.

Barn 0.9.2 brings the complete macOS guest runtime to the Apple Silicon
download and Homebrew installation.

## Changes

- The Darwin arm64 archive contains `barn`, `barn-hosts-helper`, and
  `Barn.app` from the same source commit. All three executables are signed
  with Developer ID and submitted together for Apple notarization. The app
  carries a stapled ticket and passes Gatekeeper assessment.
- Homebrew installs the CLI, QEMU, helper, and native app with one
  `brew install pgsty/infra/barn`. The CLI discovers the app in `libexec`;
  Go and Xcode are not required for installation or use. macOS guests
  require Apple Silicon and macOS 27 or later.
- The helper is signed before its final SHA-256 is embedded in the CLI.
  Packaging verifies that the CLI and helper remain paired, including after
  the native payload is attached to the release archive.
- SSH and exec use `--` to separate Barn options from the guest command.
  SSH passes a command line to the guest shell; exec preserves individual
  arguments. Use `sh -c` explicitly for shell operators with exec.
- Linux arm64/amd64 and Intel macOS retain the CLI/helper distribution.
  Linux guests use QEMU; the native app is needed only for macOS guests.

## Install and use

```sh
brew install pgsty/infra/barn
barn version

# Linux guest
barn up
barn ssh
barn exec meta -- uname -a

# macOS guest on Apple Silicon/macOS 27+
barn mac doctor
barn mac up mac1
barn mac open mac1
barn mac ssh mac1
```

The first macOS VM requires Apple's restore image and a base installation.
An existing compatible IPSW can be supplied with `barn mac setup --ipsw PATH`.

Existing Homebrew users can run `brew update` and
`brew upgrade pgsty/infra/barn`. Stop macOS VMs before replacing the app.
VM disks and configuration remain in `~/.barn`; no VM recreation is required.
For the download installer, select `BARN_VERSION=0.9.2` explicitly because
GitHub's `releases/latest` endpoint does not select pre-releases.

The release includes four platform archives, Linux DEB/RPM packages, SPDX
inventories, checksums, the installer, and the generated Homebrew formula.
See `release.json` for the exact source commit and pinned build tools.

# Barn 0.9.2（中文）

发布日期：2026-10-30。Barn 0.x 版本继续使用 GitHub 预发布频道。

本次将完整的 macOS 虚拟机组件纳入 Apple Silicon 发行包和 Homebrew 安装。

- Darwin arm64 归档包含同一次源码提交构建的 `barn`、
  `barn-hosts-helper` 和 `Barn.app`。三个可执行文件均使用 Developer ID
  签名并一起提交 Apple 公证；App 装订公证票据并通过 Gatekeeper 检查。
- `brew install pgsty/infra/barn` 一次安装 CLI、QEMU、helper 和原生 App。
  CLI 自动发现 `libexec` 下的 App，用户不需要安装 Go 或 Xcode。
  macOS 虚拟机要求 Apple Silicon 与 macOS 27 或更新版本。
- helper 先签名，再将最终 SHA-256 写入 CLI；打包和装配发行资产后均检查配对。
- SSH / exec 使用 `--` 分隔 Barn 参数和客户机命令。SSH 将命令行交给客户机
  shell，exec 保留独立参数；需要管道或重定向时显式使用 `sh -c`。
- Linux arm64/amd64 与 Intel macOS 继续提供 CLI/helper。Linux 客户机使用
  QEMU，只有 macOS 客户机需要原生 App。

Linux 客户机使用 `barn up`、`barn ssh`；macOS 客户机使用
`barn mac up mac1`、`barn mac open mac1` 和 `barn mac ssh mac1`。
首次创建 macOS 客户机需要 Apple 恢复镜像及基础系统安装，也可通过
`barn mac setup --ipsw PATH` 使用已有的兼容 IPSW。

现有用户执行 `brew update` 和 `brew upgrade pgsty/infra/barn`。
替换 App 前先停止 macOS 虚拟机；磁盘和配置仍在 `~/.barn`，无需重建。
下载安装器需显式指定 `BARN_VERSION=0.9.2`。
